searchText: Shower thought: what if geth implemented a transaction ordering solution to make frontrunning harder / less profitable while nethermind and other clients delayed this implementation. Could that fix our client diversity problem? 😄 this gave me an idea. If someone knows subtle differences in the behaviour of all major implementations regarding devp2p, you can probably construct a crawler that can quite accurately identify all the critical infrastructure points and their implementation exchange nodes are those where exchange withdrawal transactions are emanating from miners are those where the blocks are coming from first wallets are those where non-exchange transactions are emanating from > subtle differences in the behaviour of all major implementations regarding devp2p Would that be needed? Unless they explicitly mod the client, the client identifies itself in the p2p handshake in a simple version, it won't be needed, agree
